info.title: OMA LwM2M LwM2M v1.0 Test Object (Object ID 3441)

LwM2M_v1.0_Test_Object.label: LwM2M v1.0 Test Object
LwM2M_v1.0_Test_Object.description: This object is for use in interoperability tests of the LwM2M v1.0 technical specification. It contains resources for each available datatype.

Arguments_List.label: Arguments List
Arguments_List.description: List of Arguments from last execute on "Exec With Arguments"(3) resource. This resource is not affected by the "Randomize values"(1) executable resource.

Opaque_Value.label: Opaque Value
Opaque_Value.description: Initial value must be the bytes sequence "0123456789ABCDEF" (Hexadecimal notation).

Time_Value.label: Time Value
Time_Value.description: Initial value must be the time to an 1st, 2000 in the UTC time zone. (Timestamp value : 946684800)

ObjLink_Value.label: ObjLink Value
ObjLink_Value.description: Initial value must be a link to instance 0 of Device Object 3 (3:0).

Multiple_String_Value.label: Multiple String Value
Multiple_String_Value.description: Initial value must be 1 instance with ID 0 and value "initial value".

Multiple_Integer_Value.label: Multiple Integer Value
Multiple_Integer_Value.description: Initial value must be 1 instance with ID 0 and value "1024".

Multiple_Float_Value.label: Multiple Float Value
Multiple_Float_Value.description: Initial value must be 1 instance with ID 0 and value "3.14159".

Multiple_Boolean_Value.label: Multiple Boolean Value
Multiple_Boolean_Value.description: Initial value must be 1 instance with ID 0 and value "true".

Multiple_Opaque_Value.label: Multiple Opaque Value
Multiple_Opaque_Value.description: Initial value must be 1 instance with ID 0 and value "0123456789ABCDEF"(Hexadecimal notation of the bytes sequence).

Multiple_Time_Value.label: Multiple Time Value
Multiple_Time_Value.description: Initial value must be 1 instance with ID 0 and value 1st, 2000 in the UTC time zone (Timestamp value : 946684800).

Multiple_ObjLink_Value.label: Multiple ObjLink Value
Multiple_ObjLink_Value.description: Initial value must be 1 instance with ID 0 and value "3:0".

Reset_values.label: Reset values
Reset_values.description: Reset all resources of this object with their initial value.

Randomize_values.label: Randomize values
Randomize_values.description:
Set random value to all resources. For multi-instance resources, the number of resource instances is also randomized.
Randomization should avoid to generate too big payload. We advice to limit value to something like : 
 - 20 characters for String,
 - 20 bytes for Opaque,
 - 10 instances for multi-instance resources.

Clear_values.label: Clear values
Clear_values.description:
Clear all values : 
 - all multiple resource as empty resource
 - all number to 0
 - String to empty string
 - boolean to false,
 - opaque to empty byte array,
 - time to an 1st, 1970 in the UTC time zone
 - objlink to null link

Exec_With_Arguments.label: Exec With Arguments
Exec_With_Arguments.description:
This resources can be used to test "Execute Operation" with Arguments.
Sent Arguments can be read via "Arguments List"(4) resource.
E.g. If you send an Exec /3441/0/3 with "3='stringValue',4" as arguments value,
     then /3441/0/4/3 will be 'stringValue' and /3441/0/4/4 will be an empty string.
